config_coupling.effect: Each admitted plain invocation splits on whitespace and qualifies a verification run only when its argument vector matches exactly. The delivery proof guard and integration tooling check consume that comparison; declaring an invocation does not run it or supply passing evidence. A candidate branch cannot declare its own qualifying command. When no manifest resolves on the default ref, both guards skip the comparison and any otherwise qualifying passing run counts.
config_coupling.source: ResolveWorkProjectTooling loads .concord/tooling.v1.json from the work item's primary Project default ref, never its working tree. ParseProjectToolingManifest admits tool IDs and plain argument-vector invocations.
